tools.name: adafruitio_get_user
tools.description: The Adafruit IO account this key belongs to: id, name, username, time zone, created/updated times, plus the data rate limit when reported. GET /api/v2/user.

tools.name: adafruitio_get_throttle
tools.description: The account's data rate limit (data-record modifications per minute: 30 on free accounts, 60 on Plus) and the current active data rate. Check it before publishing many points. GET /api/v2/{username}/throttle.

tools.name: adafruitio_list_feeds
tools.description: List all of the account's feeds with key, name, description, unit, visibility, enabled flag, last value and last update. GET /feeds.

tools.name: adafruitio_get_feed
tools.description: One feed by key: name, description, unit, visibility, last value, status settings and the groups it belongs to. GET /feeds/{feed_key}.

tools.name: adafruitio_get_feed_details
tools.description: A feed with its details block: first and last data point and the number of stored points. GET /feeds/{feed_key}/details.

tools.name: adafruitio_list_feed_data
tools.description: Data points of a feed (max 1000 per call). Newest first, except that with start_time the API returns the oldest page after that time. Filter by time range and limit; to read further back call again with the reply's next_page_args (the same filters plus `before`). GET /feeds/{feed_key}/data.

tools.name: adafruitio_get_last_data
tools.description: The most recent data point of a feed (value, location, created_at). GET /feeds/{feed_key}/data/last.

tools.name: adafruitio_get_data_point
tools.description: One stored data point of a feed by its id. GET /feeds/{feed_key}/data/{id}.

tools.name: adafruitio_get_feed_chart
tools.description: Aggregated chart data for a feed: values sliced by `resolution` minutes over the last `hours` (or a start/end range), using avg, sum, min, max, val or val_count. Good for trends without downloading every point. GET /feeds/{feed_key}/data/chart.

tools.name: adafruitio_list_groups
tools.description: List the account's groups (named sets of feeds) with their feeds. GET /groups.

tools.name: adafruitio_get_group
tools.description: One group by key with its feeds. GET /groups/{group_key}.

tools.name: adafruitio_list_dashboards
tools.description: List the account's dashboards with key, name, description and visibility. GET /dashboards.

tools.name: adafruitio_list_blocks
tools.description: The blocks (widgets: gauges, toggles, charts, sliders...) of a dashboard with their feeds, position and properties. Integration secrets in properties are removed. GET /dashboards/{dashboard_key}/blocks.

tools.name: adafruitio_list_activities
tools.description: The account's activity log (feed/data/dashboard changes), optionally within a time range. GET /activities.

tools.name: adafruitio_publish_data_point
tools.description: WRITE: publish one data point (a value) to a feed. This can drive REAL DEVICES: anything subscribed to the feed (relays, motors, lights, heaters, locks, dashboard toggles) will receive and may act on the value, and it cannot be undone from here. Only publish a value the user has asked for. Counts ag

tools.name: adafruitio_create_feed
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty feed (private by default), optionally inside an existing group. Adds a feed only; it does not change or delete anything existing, and fails if the name is taken. POST /feeds.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "adafruitio_list_blocks" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: adafruitio_list_feeds, adafruitio_get_feed, adafruitio_get_feed_details, adafruitio_list_feed_data, adafruitio_get_last_data, adafruitio_get_data_point, adafruitio_get_feed_chart, adafruitio_list_groups, adafruitio_get_group, adafruitio_list_blocks, adafruitio_list_activities, adafruitio_publish_data_point · Private data: adafruitio_get_throttle, adafruitio_list_blocks, adafruitio_create_feed · Public sink: adafruitio_publish_data_point, adafruitio_create_feed · Destructive: adafruitio_create_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: adafruitio_list_feeds, adafruitio_get_feed, adafruitio_get_feed_details, adafruitio_list_feed_data, adafruitio_get_last_data, adafruitio_get_data_point, adafruitio_get_feed_chart, adafruitio_list_groups, adafruitio_get_group, adafruitio_list_blocks, adafruitio_list_activities, adafruitio_publish_data_point · Private data: adafruitio_get_throttle, adafruitio_list_blocks, adafruitio_create_feed · Public sink: adafruitio_publish_data_point, adafruitio_create_feed · Destructive: adafruitio_create_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
